description: Create a discount code. `type` is 'percentage' (value 0-100), 'fixed' (value in minor currency units, requires currency e.g. 'USD'), or 'free_shipping' (value 0). Optional limits: minSubtotal, maxUses, startsAt, endsAt. Only call AFTER the user explicitly agreed to the code you described.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, required for 'fixed' type, omit otherwise

minSubtotal.description: Minimum order subtotal in minor units

startsAt.description: ISO date-time the code becomes valid

value.description: Percent (0-100), fixed amount in minor units, or 0

name: create_discount
